about_the_game:
You woke up to find your that home had been broken into, your food stolen, and your beloved cat, "El Bastardo" was missing.

A quick investigation made it obvious that it was the work of Orcs and as far as you could tell, your cat was still alive.

As a retired professional soldier, you know your way around a sword, even if you're a bit rusty. The Orcs left an obvious trail, and the location of their main camps are well-known, so there's nothing left to do but go after them.

You'll stop at nothing to get the little bastard back alive no matter how many Orcs you have to go through in this third-person action RPG with real-time sword combat.

Travel through a semi-open world, fighting orcs and tracking them through the hills, forests, rivers, and canyons, improving your skills and equipment and preparing to take on the Orc Chieftain and rescue your best friend. It's a daunting task, so hopefully you can find some help along the way. Maybe the Forest Witch can spare a potion or two if she doesn't decide to eat you?
